name: MediaOps
description: MediaOps is a self-hosted, single-tenant Discord automation platform for media-server communities. Each operator creates their own Discord application/bot and connects this container to their own Emby, Ombi and Watch Party services.

paths.name: MediaOps Data
paths.description: Persistent MediaOps runtime data and scheduled Watch Party state.

variables.name: Bot Display Name
variables.description: Public-facing bot name used by MediaOps panels and messages. This does not rename your Discord application itself.

variables.name: Media Server Display Name
variables.description: Friendly media-server/community name used in public MediaOps panels.

variables.name: Demo Mode
variables.description: Set true for public/demo deployments. MediaOps keeps Watch Party controls visible but disables join links so configured Watch Party URLs are never emitted into Discord.

variables.name: Media Provider
variables.description: Media provider backend. Emby is currently supported.

variables.name: Discord Token
variables.description: Secret token for the Discord bot/application you created for this MediaOps deployment.

variables.name: Discord Client ID
variables.description: Application/client ID for your Discord application.

variables.name: Discord Guild ID
variables.description: Discord server/guild ID for this self-hosted deployment and guild-scoped command registration.

variables.name: Emby URL
variables.description: Emby base URL reachable from this container.

variables.name: Emby API Key
variables.description: Emby API key used by MediaOps.

variables.name: Request Provider
variables.description: Optional request backend. Use ombi to enable /request after configuring Ombi URL and API key.

variables.name: Ombi URL
variables.description: Ombi base URL reachable from MediaOps. Required when REQUEST_PROVIDER=ombi.

variables.name: Ombi API Key
variables.description: Ombi API key used to search and create requests. Required when REQUEST_PROVIDER=ombi.

variables.name: Ombi Auto Approve
variables.description: true automatically approves newly created requests; false leaves them pending for an Ombi administrator.

variables.name: Media Requests Forum ID
variables.description: Optional Discord Forum channel used for Ombi request lifecycle synchronization.

variables.name: Media Requests Webhook ID
variables.description: Exact Discord webhook ID allowed to drive Forum status changes. This is an ID, not the secret webhook URL/token.

variables.name: Requested Status Tag ID
variables.description: Discord Forum tag ID for newly submitted requests.

variables.name: Processing Status Tag ID
variables.description: Discord Forum tag ID for approved/in-process requests.

variables.name: Available Status Tag ID
variables.description: Discord Forum terminal tag ID for available media.

variables.name: Failed Status Tag ID
variables.description: Discord Forum terminal tag ID for failed processing/acquisition.

variables.name: Denied Status Tag ID
variables.description: Discord Forum terminal tag ID for denied/rejected requests.

variables.name: Movie Media Tag ID
variables.description: Discord Forum tag ID identifying movie requests.

variables.name: Series Media Tag ID
variables.description: Discord Forum tag ID identifying TV-series requests.

variables.name: Watch Party URL
variables.description: Public URL of the Watch Party service. Demo Mode prevents this URL from being emitted into Discord.

variables.name: Watch Party Internal URL
variables.description: Optional LAN/internal Watch Party URL used by MediaOps API calls.

variables.name: Watch Party Emby User
variables.description: Dedicated non-admin Emby account used to create and host Watch Parties.

variables.name: Watch Party Emby Password
variables.description: Password for the dedicated Watch Party Emby account.

variables.name: Watch Party Retention Days
variables.description: Days to keep completed/cancelled Watch Party history.

variables.name: MediaOps Locale
variables.description: Default language for automated messages. Supported: en or fr.

variables.name: MediaOps Timezone
variables.description: IANA timezone used for Watch Party scheduling input without an explicit offset.

variables.name: MediaOps Data Directory
variables.description: Container path for persistent runtime data.
